title: Ask HN: Please stop writing tutorials/tech articles on Medium
guide_zh: 发帖者反对把技术教程放在 Medium，认为付费墙限制了知识获取。
author: gls2ro
excerpt: Let me put this as simple as I can: Writing tutorials on Medium means you are putting them behind a paywall, thus restricting learning opportunities. Medium is not StackOverflow, it limits the number of articles that can be freely read. If you ever learned something from a blog or from stackoverflow do contribute back by sharing your knowledge open on the internet not behind a paywall.
